contracts.name: SwapShell
contracts.description: Entry-point router wrapper. Use the proxy address for all swap integrations.

contracts.name: ArcusSettlement
contracts.description: Settlement contract; routes SwapShell -> executor and enforces balance-delta accounting.

contracts.name: RfqExecutor
contracts.description: Ordinary RFQ executor (maker fill against taker order).

contracts.name: WrappedTokenRfqExecutor
contracts.description: RFQ executor for wrapped-token mints; routes into WrappedTokenEscrow.

contracts.name: WrappedTokenFactory
contracts.description: Deploys per-token wrapped-token BeaconProxy instances at CREATE2-predicted addresses.

contracts.name: WrappedTokenEscrow
contracts.description: Holds wrapped-token settlement state and deadlines.

contracts.name: WrappedToken
contracts.description: Beacon implementation for wrapped tokens. Each wrapped token is a BeaconProxy at a factory-predicted address; bind this ABI to any such address. No single canonical address.

contracts.name: WrappedTokenBeacon
contracts.description: OpenZeppelin UpgradeableBeacon pointing every WrappedToken BeaconProxy at the current implementation.
